available.quote: An individual who is currently licensed as a resident public adjuster in another state or territory may apply to the department for a nonresident public adjuster license.

requirements.value: Applicant must submit a completed application, proof of current home state license, and required license fee. Department may deny if home state does not award nonresident licenses to PA residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: The department may deny the application if the individual's home state does not award nonresident public adjuster licenses to resident licensees of this Commonwealth on the same basis.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misrepresentation of the terms and effect of any insurance contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misrepresentation of the terms and effect of any insurance contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or attempting to engage in fraudulent or misleading conduct with respect to a claim or loss.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in, or attempting to engage in, any fraudulent or misleading conduct with respect to a claim or loss that the licensee is adjusting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of the services offered or the fees or commission to be charged.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of the services offered or the fees or commission to be charged.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea of nolo contendere to a felony under applicable laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by any court of or a plea of nolo contendere to a felony under the laws of this Commonwealth, any other state, the United States or any territory or foreign country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriation, conversion or improper withholding of moneys held on behalf of another party.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misappropriation, conversion to his own use or improper withholding of moneys held on behalf of another party to the contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying compensation or things of value to any person as an inducement to influence contracting of public adjuster services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or causing to be paid any commission or any other compensation or thing of value whatsoever to any agent, broker, attorney, partner, clerk, servant, employee or any other person... as an inducement or solicitation to influence the contracting of services for the services of public adjuster with any insured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving compensation from salvage, repair or demolition businesses without disclosure to the insured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receiving, directly or indirectly, any compensation, commission or thing of value or profit from any person, partnership, association or corporation engaged or interested in the business of salvage, repair, replacement, restoration, renovation or demolition of damaged property... unless such compensation, commission or thing of value or profit is disclosed to the insured and agreed to in the contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Closing of a licensee's office for more than 30 days without permission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Closing of a licensee's office for a period in excess of 30 days, unless granted permission by the Insurance Commissioner to close the office for a longer period.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this act or any rule or regulation promulgated thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this act or any rule or regulation promulgated, published and adopted thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material misstatement in the application for any license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a material misstatement in the application for any such license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The commission of fraudulent practices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of fraudulent practices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrating incompetency or untrustworthiness to transact the business of a public adjuster.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demonstrating, in the judgment of the Insurance Commissioner, his incompetency or untrustworthiness to transact the business of a public adjuster.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a public adjuster or other professional license denied, suspended or revoked by a governmental or self-regulating professional body.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a public adjuster license or other professional license, or its equivalent, denied, suspended or revoked by a governmental entity or self-regulating professional association.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay state income tax or comply with any order directing payment thereof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay State income tax or comply with any administrative or court order directing the payment of State income tax.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a misdemeanor involving misuse or theft of money or property belonging to another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a misdemeanor that involves the misuse or theft of money or property belonging to another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the department of a change of address within 30 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the department of a change of address within 30 days.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting business during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence such as a fire, tornado, or other catastrophe.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting business during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence such as a fire, tornado, severe storm or other catastrophe where the immediate safety and security of persons and property is paramount.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prohibiting communication between the insurer and the insured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prohibiting communication between the insurer and the insured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the insured's insurer within two calendar days of entering into a contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the insured's insurer within two calendar days of entering into a contract.

bonding_required.quote: Each person receiving a public adjuster's license shall, before transacting any business thereunder, execute and deliver to the Insurance Commissioner a bond in the minimum penal sum of $20,000

definition_quote.value: Any person advertising, soliciting business or holding himself out to the public as an adjuster of claims for losses or damages arising out of policies of insurance, surety or indemnity upon property, persons or insurable business interests within this Commonwealth, and receiving any compensation or reward for the giving of advice or assistance to the insured in the adjustment of claims for such losses, or who for compensation or reward, whether by way of salary or commission or otherwise, directly or indirectly, solicits business, investigates or adjusts losses or advises the insured with reference to claims for losses on behalf of any other person engaged in the business of adjusting losses.
definition_quote.quote: Any person advertising, soliciting business or holding himself out to the public as an adjuster of claims for losses or damages arising out of policies of insurance, surety or indemnity upon property, persons or insurable business interests within this Commonwealth, and receiving any compensation or reward for the giving of advice or assistance to the insured in the adjustment of claims for such losses, or who for compensation or reward, whether by way of salary or commission or otherwise, directly or indirectly, solicits business, investigates or adjusts losses or advises the insured with reference to claims for losses on behalf of any other person engaged in the business of adjusting losses.

value: advising the insured with reference to claims for losses
methods_authorized.quote: solicits business, investigates or adjusts losses or advises the insured with reference to claims for losses on behalf of any other person engaged in the business of adjusting losses

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: Upon designating one or more officers or partners licensed under this act to be responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and regulations of the Commonwealth, a business entity may apply to the department for a public adjuster license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: Upon designating one or more officers or partners licensed under this act to be responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and regulations of the Commonwealth, a business entity may apply to the department for a public adjuster license.

resident_vs_nonresident_license_types.quote: An individual who is a resident of this Commonwealth may apply to the department for a resident public adjuster license. An individual who is not a resident of this Commonwealth may apply for a nonresident public adjuster license.

fingerprint_background_check_required.quote: the applicant's fingerprints, for the department to receive national criminal history records information from the Criminal Justice Information Services Division of the Federal Bureau of Investigation

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: No license as a public adjuster shall be issued to any person engaged or interested in, or receiving any profit from, nor shall the holder of any such license engage or be interested in, or receive any profit from, any salvage or similar business.

surety_bond_required.quote: Each person receiving a public adjuster's license shall, before transacting any business thereunder, execute and deliver to the Insurance Commissioner a bond in the minimum penal sum of $20,000

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: execute and deliver to the Insurance Commissioner a bond in the minimum penal sum of $20,000

written_contract_required.quote: No public adjuster shall, directly or indirectly, act within this Commonwealth as a public adjuster without having first entered into a contract, in writing, on a form approved by the department and executed in duplicate by the public adjuster and the insured or a duly authorized representative.

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: That the insured has the right to rescind the contract within three calendar days after signature.

insurer_notification_deadline_days.quote: Failing to notify the insured's insurer within two calendar days of entering into a contract.

financial_interest_disclosure_required.quote: A public adjuster shall provide the insured a written disclosure concerning a direct or indirect financial interest the public adjuster has with another party involved in an aspect of the claim

prohibited_claim_types.quote: No public adjuster shall act in any manner in relation to claims for personal injury or automobile property damage.

claims_only_against_own_insurer.quote: No public adjuster may adjust or solicit a contract for the adjustment of any claim for losses or damages on behalf of any person except claims by an insured against his own insurance carrier.

repair_contract_prohibition_before_settl.quote: No public adjuster shall, directly or indirectly, through or with any person, partnership, corporation or association in which it has an indirect or beneficial interest, enter into any contract with any insured for the repair, replacement, restoration, renovation or demolition of damaged property, real or personal, at any time prior to the date a verdict or award is entered or payment is received from the insurance carrier, whichever event shall occur first.

catastrophe_solicitation_prohibited.quote: Soliciting business during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence such as a fire, tornado, severe storm or other catastrophe where the immediate safety and security of persons and property is paramount.

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: impose a civil penalty of not more than $5,000 for each and every violation of this act.

license_fee_initial.quote: A nonrefundable $200 fee shall accompany a completed application for a resident or nonresident public adjuster license
